title: Diwali Celebration
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Horizons celebrated Diwali on 23rd October 2026 at Mahogany Hall, The Club, with a spectacular evening of music, entertainment and festive cheer.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Horizons celebrated Diwali on 23rd October 2026 at Mahogany Hall, The Club, with a spectacular evening of music, entertainment and festive cheer. The celebration featured a live singer, exciting games, special surprises and a delicious festive dinner. Members enjoyed the exclusive Diwali hampers and wonderful fellowship, making it an evening filled with joy, laughter and unforgettable memories!
